cpmplus.w3settings.menu.hub.desc: Arm type, skull, armor, bed, glow and the other model settings
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.title: Model settings
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.armType.desc: Steve: wide arms (4 px). Alex: slim arms (3 px).
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.adjustArms.desc: Changes the arm cubes (and the 2nd layer sleeves) to the new type, as one Ctrl+Z step. The texture is not repainted.
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.noAdjustWarn: Without adjusting, the current arms don't match the new type: on export they become custom cubes (the normal arm and the 2nd layer sleeve disappear).
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.hideHead: Hide the head when wearing a skull
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.armorOffset.desc: Use it if the armor floats outside the model. (On by default, recommended.)
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.invisGlow: Glow stays visible with an invisibility potion
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.done.undoAll: Done: %s. Click here to undo everything (Ctrl+Z undoes only the cubes).
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.undoCubesManually: The settings were undone. For the arm cubes use Ctrl+Z (you changed other things since).
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.textureWarn: The texture was not repainted: check the arms on the skin (Alex arms are 3 px wide, Steve arms 4 px).
cpmplus.w3settings.hub.skipped: These cubes were edited, so they were left alone: %s
cpmplus.w3settings.msg.undoOtherProject: Can't undo: open the project where the change was made.
cpmplus.w3settings.desc.title: Name, description and icon
cpmplus.w3settings.desc.name: Model name
cpmplus.w3settings.desc.icon.new: new icon (256×256), saved when you confirm
cpmplus.w3settings.desc.icon.removed: will be removed when you confirm
cpmplus.w3settings.desc.icon.note: The icon is always 256×256 (CPM ignores other sizes): other images are cropped in the middle and resized.
cpmplus.w3settings.desc.icon.err.notPng: This file is not a PNG. Choose a .png image.
cpmplus.w3settings.desc.icon.err.decode: This image can't be read. Try another PNG.
cpmplus.w3settings.desc.icon.err.noImpor: Choosing files is not available here.
cpmplus.w3settings.desc.icon.err.shot: Couldn't take the screenshot. Keep the 3D view open and try again, or choose a PNG.
cpmplus.w3settings.prot.title: Who can copy
cpmplus.w3settings.prot.uuidLock: Lock to the account that exports it in game
cpmplus.w3settings.prot.client: Only the client (lock to one account)
cpmplus.w3settings.prot.normal.info: Normal: in game the 'Clone' button is not shown to people who see you. It doesn't stop every kind of copy.
cpmplus.w3settings.prot.cloneable.info: Cloneable: anyone with CPM who sees you can save a copy of the model to wear (not the editable project), and the copies are cloneable too. Good for free models, bad for commissions or paid models.
cpmplus.w3settings.prot.uuidLock.info: The lock is applied when you export the model from CPM's editor in game, to the account that exports it. The .cpmproject is not locked.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.kind.desc: A lock stores ONE UUID only: it can't cover an original and an offline server at the same time.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.kind.offline.lon: Offline / cracked server (only works on that kind of server)
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.webNote: The lookup doesn't work on the Blockbench website (Mojang blocks it): paste the UUID. You can find it on namemc.com or in the server log.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.offlineWarn: The nick must be written exactly like on the server, capital letters count ('Joao' is not 'joao'). If the client changes their nick, the lock breaks.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.checkLog: Check the server log: the line 'UUID of player <nick> is …' must show this same UUID.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.honest: Stops use with another account and makes simple theft harder. It is NOT encryption: whoever wears or watches with that UUID gets through, and anyone who edits the file can remove the lock. You (the artist) won't see the locked model in game either.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.err.noUuidPremiu: Look up the UUID by nick (installed Blockbench only) or paste the client's UUID.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.err.badUuid: This UUID is not valid: it needs 32 letters/digits (0-9, a-f), with or without hyphens.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.err.webMc: This UUID is Blockbench's own temporary profile, not the client's. Paste the UUID of the client's account.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.err.webLookup: The lookup doesn't work on the Blockbench website (Mojang blocks it). Paste the UUID: you can find it on namemc.com or in the server log.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.err.notFound: Couldn't find the account '%s'. Check the nick or paste the UUID.
cpmplus.w3settings.lock.err.lookupFailed: Couldn't look it up now (no internet or Mojang didn't answer). Paste the client's UUID.
cpmplus.w3settings.size.title: Size and attributes
cpmplus.w3settings.size.intro: 1 = normal. Values other than 1 only work on a server if the staff enables them (see 'What the server must enable').
cpmplus.w3settings.size.entitySlider.des: Drag from 0.1 to 3. For other values (up to 10), type in the field below.
cpmplus.w3settings.size.showAttrs.desc: The server decides whether to enable each attribute.
cpmplus.w3settings.size.attrsWarn: Attributes change gameplay (health, damage, speed): the server decides whether to enable them. If not enabled, they stay normal.
cpmplus.w3settings.size.showRender.desc: Moves, rotates or scales only the drawing of the model. It doesn't change the hitbox or the eye height.
cpmplus.w3settings.size.clamped: Some values were beyond CPM's limits and were adjusted: %s
cpmplus.w3settings.size.serverToast: %s value(s) must be enabled by the server staff. Click to see the commands.
cpmplus.w3settings.server.title: What the server must enable
cpmplus.w3settings.server.nothing: Nothing to enable: the model doesn't change size or attributes.
cpmplus.w3settings.server.onlyFree: Nothing to enable: the model only uses options that are enabled on every server.
cpmplus.w3settings.server.line.size: %s %sx: OFF on servers by default. Without enabling it, you stay normal.
cpmplus.w3settings.server.nick.desc: Empty = '<nick>' in the text (replace it later).
cpmplus.w3settings.server.useAll.warn: Careful: enables ALL of them, combat attributes included. The exact list is safer.
cpmplus.w3settings.server.limits: If the staff had already set limits
cpmplus.w3settings.server.limits.desc: Adds 'limit' commands for this player only (never changes everybody's limit).
cpmplus.w3settings.server.notes:
• The server needs the CPM mod/plugin.
• Hitbox, eyes and attributes need a scaling method on the server (Pehkui, or Minecraft attributes on newer versions). If debug says 'unavailable', no command fixes it.
• If the staff used 'method off', the option stays off.
• After enabling, apply the model again or log in again.
cpmplus.w3settings.server.staffMessage:
Hi! I use a Custom Player Models model that changes: %s. Servers have this off by default. Could you enable it with these commands?

%s

The last command (debug of %s) shows whether it is 'enabled'. If it says 'unavailable', the server needs a scaling method (Pehkui, or Minecraft attributes on newer versions). After that I'll apply the model again or log in again. Thanks!
cpmplus.w3settings.warn.cloneable: Cloneable: anyone with CPM who sees you can save a copy (the .cpmmodel, to wear, not the editable project); the copies are cloneable too. Good for free models, bad for commissions or paid models.
cpmplus.w3settings.warn.cloneable.ifIgno: In game, people who see you get a 'Clone' button.
cpmplus.w3settings.warn.uuidLockInGame: Lock to account: the lock is applied when you export the model from CPM's editor in game, to the account that exports it. This .cpmproject is not locked.
cpmplus.w3settings.warn.scalingServer: This model uses %s size/attribute option(s) that servers block by default.
cpmplus.w3settings.open.cloneable: This project is marked Cloneable: people who see you in game can save a copy (and the copies too). Click to see the options.
cpmplus.w3settings.open.uuidLock: This project is marked 'Lock to account' without an owner: the lock applies when you export from CPM's editor in game. To lock it to a client, choose the owner before exporting a .cpmmodel. Click to see the options.
